text:
anna_marketing: Heads-up — benchmark blog + data release scheduled TOMORROW 10:00 PST (embargo until 11:00 UTC). Need press standby, social queue, and CDN check. Assets: https://drive.redwood/inference/benchmarks/pack.zip. @josh_ops can you confirm CDN sync + cache warm? @cecilia_pm we need a final CEO quote in the one-pager. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
josh_ops: On it. I'll run a CDN purge plan and warm caches at T-20m, then a verification sweep at T-5m. What's the canonical landing slug? I need the full URLs for prewarm.
cecilia_pm: Quote is approved — short and long versions in the doc: https://docs.redwood/benchmarks/quotes. Use the short one for tweets. Also cc legal for the stats line.
sam_engineering: FYI we should temp-bump the rate limit for anonymous widgets for 30m post-publish. I'll set a rule: /widgets/* -> rate limit x2 from 10:00-10:40 PST.
press_bot: Press list updated: 47 outlets. Embargo note set to 11:00 UTC. Journalists with embargo agreements flagged. :white_check_mark:
lisa_seo: SEO ops done except OG image tweak — I'll swap the image at T-10m. @anna_marketing please confirm canonical tag points to /benchmarks/2026-03. Also setting twitter_card to summary_large_image.
evan_support: Support on standby with paste templates for known FAQs. Sharing internal slack alias: #support-bench.
anna_marketing: Quick embargo/play checklist (paste this to PRs & comms threads):
```
1) T-60m: Final assets locked in drive + legal sign-off.
2) T-30m: CDN warm + cache pre-populate (ops).
3) T-20m: SEO image swap + canonical check.
4) T-15m: Social queue armed; QA links in staging.
5) T-5m: Rate-limit bump + canary smoke test.
6) Publish (10:00 PST): flip live, announce to press (embed notes).
7) T+5m: verify ingestion metrics, load, and error rate.
8) T+30m: scale-down temporary rules, post-mortem notes if anything unusual.
```
anna_marketing: Copy for press release (approved): "Redwood Inference today published benchmark results showing X% improvement in per-token latency for common chat workloads at scale." Use the longer stat paragraph from the quotes doc for press.
josh_ops: CDN prewarm plan: will POST to /prewarm with list of 1200 URLs; I'll share the job ID in channel at T-25m.
cecilia_pm: Media contact matrix: Sarah (US tech), Mateo (EU finance), Priya (data infra). Use these handles for embargo calls. Numbers in the doc.
lisa_seo: Reminder: noindex staging pages until publish. I'll re-check robots at T-10m.
evan_support: I'll prep 3 canned replies for highest-likelihood questions and pin them to #support-bench.
anna_marketing: Final ask — everyone confirm by EOD if you need additional headcount or a dedicated pager during launch. I'll do a final preflight at 09:25 PST. :rocket:
